title: Agent race
description: The same task for Claude, Codex and OpenCode, each in its own sandbox; compare time, steps and what was blocked.

de.title: Agenten-Rennen

prompt: Race task: {task}. Work as fast and as cleanly as you can; when done, write /work/race/RESULT.md with what you did and how long it took.
